text:
Samir: Heads-up — staged rollout of v2.3 starts in ~45m. Need a quick check on p95/p99, any perf regressions, and rollback readiness. Can SRE/ops confirm artifacts + go/no-go? @Alex @Marta

Canary-Bot: canary run started 1792468000; health checks: 3/3 services green; p95=138ms; throughput stable. Report: https://staging-ci/reports/1792468000

Alex: Pulled profiles. Baseline p95=120ms, canary p95=138ms (+15%). p99 190->215ms (+13%). Saw a CPU allocator spike around 30s but sustained <10% overhead. Not ideal but possibly acceptable if fallback is ready.

Marta: Noted a +8% KV cache miss rate on the canary. Pushed a quick tweak to reduce max_batch from 8 -> 6 to try and reduce tails. Ran:```bash
./run_canary --model=redwood-v2 --batch-max=6 --seq=512
```
Early numbers: p95 -> 128ms. Let it run another 10m to confirm.

Ops-Bot: Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-canary/artifacts/1792468000/profiles.tar.gz (sha256: abc123def456...). Contains flamegraphs, alloc traces, perf logs.

Jess: Product — any sign of quality regressions in the smoke eval? @Marta

Marta: Quick smoke: 2/500 minor formatting diffs, no semantic failures. Kicking off full eval (5000 prompts), ETA ~20m. Will post results.

Luke: Rollback checklist reminder: auto-rollback if p95 > 140ms for 5m OR error rate >0.5% sustained. Who actually triggers manual rollback?

Samir: Policy: auto if error rate >0.5% sustained across 3 consecutive 1m windows, otherwise manual. Ops can trigger manual rollback; I can also abort/rollforward if we have a fix. I'll be available for triage.

Alex: My recommendation: if Marta's batch tweak holds and p95 <135ms + error delta <0.2%, give green. Otherwise hold and collect deeper alloc + kernel traces. :thumbsup:

Marta: Starting deeper alloc profiling now. If anyone needs kernel-level bisecting, ping @Samir and I'll hand over traces.

Canary-Bot: canary update @ 1792468300 — p95=129ms, error rate 0.12%, KV miss rate trending down. All checks green. :white_check_mark:

Jess: Product +1 pending final eval output. :eyes:

Samir: Ok — proceed to staged rollout -> 20% for 30m. Ops, please watch the 1m windows for error spikes. If anything breaches, rollback immediately. I'll annotate the runbook with the tweak we used. Thanks all.

Alex: Copying artifact links to the incident doc for postmortem.

Luke: I'll be on-call during the window and stand by for rollback.

Marta: Noted. Will keep the canary running and post eval when done.

Samir: Closing the loop — I'll post final status after 30m.
